about: The question about the printing press and the telescope fits two tutors. The router, on Groq, picks one and only that tutor answers.
how: The router answers with JSON: the chosen specialist and the reason. Only that specialist is started.
learns: A router can choose wrongly when a question fits more than one specialist; one choice, no second opinion.
watch: The reason the router gives, and what the unchosen specialist would have said.
